why: Repair-and-defend material constantly mixes watching and fixing pixels with attack alarms and defence rallies.

why.T3-009: The item marks the room's own finished or near-finished canvas work as achieved with we-did-it posts, congratulations and pride.
why.T3-031: It also plays the room's running jokes and self-mockery around the canvas effort, not just celebration.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 cannot carry the room's self-mocking in-jokes about the canvas that are not celebrations of achievement.

multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-031; dropping it would lose the mocking/in-joke side of the assessment.
